status: tenth aggregation slice: an unchanged (receipt, pre-receipt aggregate) pair reuses the retained ordering instead of walking the term; phase-level win, end-to-end inside the host's noise floor

change.what: each destination's retained fold state now also records the pre-receipt aggregate of its last fold, the receipt that aggregate was ordered against, and the ordered result. When the new fold produces the same pre-receipt aggregate and the installed receipt is unchanged, the retained ordered result is published instead of calling retain_requirement_order.
change.why: order retention was NovyWave's second-largest refresh bucket (14.5 ms) and most folds change nothing, so the same pair recurs.
change.soundness: retain_requirement_order is a pure function of (receipt, aggregate): the reuse requires both the pre-receipt aggregate and the receipt to be identical to the retained pair. Release takes the reuse; debug builds fold normally and assert the fresh walk equals the retained result.

debug_cross_check.first_attempt: consulted the state after the fold insert, which had already published the new pre-receipt aggregate next to a carried-over receipt, so an initial state matched with ordered = None; 14 kernel tests failed on the assertion
debug_cross_check.fix: capture the previously recorded pair before the fold and only reuse it; all gates pass with the cross-check active
